notes.heading: Choose the shore before the boat

facts.text: Incredible India places the main migratory-bird season at Mangalajodi in November–February.

questions: Agree your departure shore, trip length and return with the operator; do not assume one boat trip covers the whole lagoon.
Ask about life jackets, boarding, weather cancellation and the full price before paying. For a stay, confirm the room and any boat transfer directly.

notes.heading: Let the temple be the main event

facts.text: The UNESCO entry is a heritage reference; it does not confirm today’s opening arrangements.

questions: Confirm current monument access and ticket arrangements before travelling. Ask about the walking surfaces and steps that matter to your party.
Treat a dance performance or evening show as a separate booking: confirm the dated programme, language, ticket and return transport.

notes.heading: Plan the monument and inscriptions separately

facts.text: The white Peace Pagoda is a modern monument; the older inscriptions are a separate part of the visit.

questions: Confirm the approach, walking surfaces and drop-off for both stops.
Check an evening show’s current programme and return pickup before making it the centre of your day.

notes.heading: Make room for a maker’s working day

facts.text: The district guide describes a craft community and Gotipua tradition; it is not a workshop or performance timetable.

questions: Ask whether this is a good time to visit; agree any demonstration fee before it begins.
Arrange return transport and ask permission before photographing people, homes or artwork.

notes.heading: Leave room for the day as it is

facts.text: Official destination descriptions provide ideas, not confirmation of temple access, a meal or safe swimming conditions.

questions: Confirm temple-entry eligibility, permitted belongings and current arrangements with the temple before planning a visit.
Check local beach guidance on the day; arrange meals and return travel directly rather than relying on a sample itinerary.

notes.heading: Check the reserve notice before you book

facts.text: The reserve’s guide makes seasonal opening subject to current official notices. It lists Kaliani and Pithabata entry gates, requires permits, and directs overnight bookings online. Drones are prohibited.

questions: Check the latest opening notice and which gate serves your chosen route or camp. A general season description is not confirmation that the reserve is open on your date.
Confirm permits, vehicle requirements, guide arrangements and camp availability through the official booking route.
